method: Owner reports and native-host screenshots reviewed during guided testing; automated checks are reported separately.

checks.evidence: Owner accepted the correction; both surfaces were visibly light.

checks.test: Full application restart restores light device body before monitor opens
checks.evidence: Device body already light with monitor closed, then monitor opened in the same theme.

checks.test: Saved controls, fractional visual zoom, compensation and instrumental selection survive restart
checks.evidence: Owner confirmed retained settings; basic and advanced views reviewed after restart.

checks.test: Microphone and instrumental waveforms and attack feedback during playback / recording
checks.evidence: Both waves and detected events visible; owner reported intended operation in RC1.3.

checks.test: Actual recording and automatic transport stop retain the recorded clip
checks.evidence: Owner confirmed successful operation; stopped view showed the retained clip and Live stop confirmation.

checks.test: Save automatic stop ON, fully close/reopen, initialize OFF with other settings retained
checks.evidence: ON and stopped transport confirmed before save/exit; OFF confirmed after full restart with themes and controls retained.

checks.test: Playback synchronization after the stopped-state audio diagnostic
checks.evidence: Subsequent playback showed synchronized status and both audio waveforms.

predecessor_observations: RC1.2 monitor layout, both monitor themes, unit display and untouched-silence stability are archived in history/RC1_2_HOST_OBSERVATIONS.json. They remain version-scoped observations.
limits: Acceptance applies to the owner-tested Windows / Live 12 workflow, not every host, operating system, parameter combination or audio setup.

Both directions of the RC1.3 embedded palette and per-instance isolation have automated message-model coverage; a separate native dark-body restart and native multi-instance test were not independently documented.
Screenshots confirm stop behavior and owner acceptance, not sample-accurate stop latency or the exact first-event timing.
This amplitude-onset detector can count keyboard/room sounds and speaker bleed; it does not recognize speech. Earlier untouched-silence stability is a bounded RC1.2 observation.
Global Max High DPI / Windows scaling settings were not inspected or changed; no claim of universal text sharpness is made.
privacy: Sanitized functional outcomes only. No private Live Sets, extracted diagnostic dumps, saved routing/input payloads, recordings or owner screenshots are published.
